title: SubsumptionPolicy
description: The warn/block surface and exemption scoping (spec.md §7). Resolved in layers — specification default, project config, per-run override — with 'exemptions' accumulating across layers rather than the last layer replacing the list (ADR 0016), the same treatment ADR 0008 gives 'exclude'.

on-finding.description: What a 'finding'-severity result does to the run (spec.md §7.1). ADR 0016: default 'warn'.

on-review.description: What a 'review'-severity result does to the run. ADR 0016: default 'warn' — 'unknown' is an honest answer, not a lesser finding, and blocking on it by default would punish exactly the operators §8's conservative/opaque classes exist to admit.

exemptions.description: Accepted gaps between what the provider may do and what the consumer has tested (spec.md §7.2).

Exemption.title: Exemption
Exemption.description: Every set selector must match for the exemption to apply; an unset selector matches every value on that axis (spec.md §7.2).

consumer.description: Limits the exemption to findings for this consumer name.

path.description: Limits the exemption to one field, in shape spec §6.2's path grammar.

reason.description: Required: an exemption is a team accepting a gap, and the policy document records why (ADR 0008's Exclusion.reason is the same discipline for a different axis).

expires.description: When the exemption should be revisited. Optional, since some gaps are permanent by design, but its absence SHOULD be surfaced by a report or dashboard (task 7.4/7.5).

InteractionRef.title: InteractionRef
InteractionRef.description: Identifies an interaction the same way contract spec §4.2 does — description plus state names.
